map.：算法：BAC = max(0, 饮酒量(mL)×酒精度×0.789 ÷ (分布: : algorithm: BAC = max(0, intake(mL) x alcohol content x 0.789 / (distribution factor r x weight kg) - 0.015 x hours); r = 0.68 for men and 0.55 for women, 0.789 is the ethanol density and 0.015 the metabolism rate in g/100mL/h. All values must be at least 0.
